text: Under Armour is the brand of Under Armour, Inc., a US listed sportswear company (NYSE: UA, UAA) controlled by founder Kevin A. Plank: its July 2026 proxy statement shows him holding Class A and Class B stock carrying 64.6% of the combined voting power.
short: Under Armour, Inc. is a listed US company whose founder Kevin Plank holds 64.6% of voting power.

source.name: Under Armour, Inc.: 2026 Proxy Statement (DEF 14A), security ownership of beneficial owners (SEC EDGAR)
source.note: The same table header reads 'Class A and Class B Stock ... Percentage of Voting Power'; the proxy also calls Mr. Plank 'our founder, President and Chief Executive Officer and controlling stockholder' and states each Class B share 'entitles the holder to cast ten votes'.
